notes.title: Update alert!
notes.notes:
Hey all!

Back again with some new fixes!
This update is mostly just tweaks to the movement to make it more snappy and less floaty, as some players felt it was too unresponsive. I have also tried making the game more fun instead of difficult. It will still be difficult, but more fun (at least in my opinion)

What’s Adjusted?
Changed the gravity to combat “floatines”
Tweaked all the levels to fit the new movement

What’s fixed?
Fixed a bug where the gun would freeze after firing a shot
Fixed a bug where the reload animation wouldn’t play if you reloaded immediately after firing a shot

What’s new?
Visual feedback to collecting crystals
Added a outline to the viewmodel to make it stand out more

Do you have any problem with these? bugs, glitches etc?
Please let me know, and I'll try my best to fix them!

Hope you have an awesome day/night!

Cheers,
- Vander / lilleBror

notes.title: Update v0.2.8
notes.notes:
Retro Run v0.2.8

Big news!
A new level category Kill 'em all has been released!

What's fixed?
- Fixed ''fans'' spinning in the wrong direction
- The range of the players weapon being too short
- Touch some grass achievement not working

What's new?
- Added footstep sounds
- 1 new game mode with 5 new levels
- 2 new achievements
- Outline to the enemys to make them stand out more from the background & in dark areas

What's gone?
Removed:
- Removed one of the player death sounds

Do you have any problem with these? bugs, glitches etc?
Please let me know, and I'll try my best to fix them!

Hope you have an awesome day/night!

- Vander

notes.title: UPDATE v0.1.8
notes.notes:
Update 0.1.8!

Whats new?
- Updated animations for idle, run, reload and shooting! (thanks Tengo)

- Added headbobbing for when you run

Do you have any problem with these? bugs, glitches etc?

Hope you have an awesome day/night!

notes.title: Small patch v0.0.6
notes.notes:
This patch fixes a few small bugs with the new save system.

Patch notes:
- Fixed a save system bug, where it wouldn't save the best time but the worst.
- Changed how you unlock levels. You now always have the first level of a category unlocked, so you can choose if you wanna start playing car ride or platforms.

Do you have any problem with these? bugs, glitches etc?
Please let me know, and I'll try to fix them!

Hope you have an awesome day/night!

- Vander

notes.title: Save System Update
notes.notes:
The new Save System is now released! this system makes it so much easier for me as a developer to add more content to the game.

Patch notes:
- Updated the save system.
- Added ''auto target'' feature to make it easier to use the Hookpoint in lvl 5.
- Replaced the old platform theme wit hthe new version.

Do you have any problem with these? bugs, glitches etc?
Please let me know, and I'll try to fix them!

Hope you have an awesome day/night!

- Vander

notes.title: Save System Update Info!
notes.notes:
I'll be changing the current save system with a new and better one, that makes it so much easier to add new levels to the game! that means that your old save will be sacrificed for the new one, so I recommend not to play until it is out to not lose too much of your progress. The update will be out in not too long and I'll post another announcement when it is out.

Hope you guys understand my decision and that you aren't mad, Thanks again for the support!

- Vander

notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes:
Alpha 0.0.5

Things changed:
1. You no longer slide like crazy on the ground in platforms.
2. The buttons for the different levels have been spaced out, so it doesn't look like one big button.

Things added:
1. A new help menu has been added! in platforms, go to the top right and click the question mark, this will bring you to a page where you see how key features work in the mode.
2. Better controller support has been added to the game, I still work on trying to make the UI work with controllers.
